rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a casual, unconcerned manner.

example.english: You can casually say it; I don't mind.
example.jyutping: nei5 ceoi4 bin6 gam2 gong2 ngo5 m4 gaai3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when “casually” suggests doing something without much care, preparation, or precision.

example.english: I casually wrote a few words.
example.jyutping: ngo5 kau4 kei4 gam2 se2 zo2 gei2 zek3 zi6

rows.note: Use this when the manner is relaxed and effortless rather than careless.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hing1 sung1 gam2 king1 zyu6 gai2

rows.note: Use this for acting casually or nonchalantly as though nothing unusual has happened.

example.english: They casually walked past me as if nothing had happened.
example.traditional: 佢若無其事噉行過我身邊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6 gam2 haang4 gwo3 ngo5 san1 bin1
